claim: In the matching retail DLL, EntranceScene.InitThemeMusic (0x06004833) is an instance parameterless Void method with exact signature blob 200001 and an exact 244-byte body. It computes pl_idx = this.plIdxList[this.plNum - 1], then player = PlayerMan.inst.GetPlObj(pl_idx). When player.WresParam.themeMusic is below raw Int32 10000, it calls Menu_SoundManager.Change_BGM_Theme(themeMusic, false, false) and returns. Otherwise it loads GlobalWork.inst.MatchSetting and matchWrestlerInfo[pl_idx]. If wrestlerID is raw 10000 or greater, or exactly raw -2, execution enters a data path that first calls SaveData.inst.GetEditWrestlerData(wrestlerID); when wrestlerID is -2 that local is then replaced by SaveData.get_story_data().m_pc. The method calls canonical MyMusic.Check_File(data.ThemeMusic_Filename). A false result calls Change_BGM_Theme(0,false,false) and MyMusic.Set(33,String.Empty); a true result calls MyMusic.Set(33,data.ThemeMusic_Filename). If wrestlerID is below 10000 and is not -2, the method calls Change_BGM_Theme(player.WresParam.themeMusic,false,false). FACT-0102, FACT-0099 and FACT-0100 pin the three already-canonical helper call boundaries.
